title: Shiitake Tamago Futomaki
description: Soy-mirin shiitake and tamago with crunchy carrot and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Slice shiitake and simmer with soy sauce, mirin and honey until tender and almost dry. Cool completely.
Cook eggs into a fully set layered omelet and cut into strips.
Blanch carrot strips briefly, cool and drain; slice cucumber into slender dry batons.
Spread rice on nori, arrange mushrooms, tamago, carrot and cucumber in neat stripes. Roll into thick futomaki.
Cut each roll into eight pieces with a lightly damp knife.
notes: The shiitake mixture must be cooled and well reduced so it does not wet the rice.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
